STRATEGIC FINANCE @ CLAY

We’re looking for a strategic finance rockstar who will be a key player in driving our financial strategy and fueling our growth journey. In this role, you’ll partner with our leadership team and collaborate across departments to shape financial planning, analysis, and reporting. Your insights will directly influence our decision-making and help us scale like never before. If you're ready to roll up your sleeves and make a real impact in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, we want to hear from you!




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead the development and maintenance of financial models to support strategic decision-making, ensuring alignment with the company’s growth objectives.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze and report on key financial metrics, providing insights into performance trends and areas for improvement.

 - Drive the financial planning process, including annual budgets and forecasts, while ensuring accuracy and transparency in financial reporting.

 - Enhance existing financial processes and systems to streamline operations and improve data accuracy, fostering a culture of accountability and performance.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in strategic finance, financial planning and analysis, or a related field.

 - Proven track record in building and managing complex financial models, along with strong analytical skills to derive insights from data.

 - Excellent communication skills, capable of simplifying complex financial concepts for non-financial stakeholders and building strong relationships across the organization.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, demonstrating initiative and adaptability in tackling challenges and driving results.

HEAD OF GTM STRATEGY & OPS @ CLAY

We’re excited for our Head of GTM Strategy & Ops to design and build our revenue engine so that sales, marketing, and CX are rowing in the same direction with clear accountability and real leverage. Internally you’ll be at the center of designing how we plan, inspect, incentivize, and course-correct. You’ll partner closely with our GTM leaders. Externally, you’ll immerse yourself with our customers as a practitioner-evangelist of Clay and the future of GTM.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Architect the GTM operating rhythm end-to-end: sit in every forecast call, design inspection and accountability cadences, and close inefficiencies across sales, CX, and marketing. Partner closely with our GTM leadership.

 - Design GTM process and methodology: design and implement sales process changes, develop playbooks, and create field assets

 - Define rules of engagement: establish clear swim lanes, design territory assignments, manage deal splits, and refine routing and handoffs

 - Lead implementation and change management for GTM initiatives, ensuring proper sequencing, communication, and measurement of field adoption

 - Partner with GTM Finance on planning and incentives: operationalize comp rollout, provide operational assumptions for capacity models, and collaborate on high-leverage questions like segment prioritization, connect the dots across the GTM

 - Partner with GTM Engineering and GTM Ops: to push Clay's product into new use cases, propose extensions, and contribute to our practitioner-led product feedback loop

 - Build a high-performing and supportive team, the clay way




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 10+ years of experience in business strategy, operations, and analysis with at least 5 years in revenue operations & strategy at a hyper-growth SaaS company

 - 5+ years of people management experience in hyper-growth environments: Proven track record of hiring and developing high-performing teams: you've enabled and supported impressive careers

 - You’ve implemented novel GTM strategies with measurable business impact: reinvented the playbook before from first principles and are excited to do it again

 - Exceptional quantitative modeling skills with expertise in SaaS GTM finance and measurement

 - Executive (but still grounded) presence: you communicate clearly, challenge assumptions in the room, and are comfortable saying "I don't know yet!”

 - An informed perspective on AI and real examples of how you've put it to work in your workflows or team processes

 - You’re excited to spend time speaking with our customers and community to bring Clay's best practices to market

STRATEGIC FINANCE - FP&A @ CLAY

We’re building a company that grows fast, moves fast, and makes decisions quickly, and Finance is a core part of that. The best FP&A functions at companies are inherently strategic, and lean on the “analysis” - they not only create a clear source of truth and planning cadence, but surface risk and opportunity early, and own what happens next with cross-functional partners.

We’re looking for an FP&A owner to build the financial systems, forecasting processes, and operating rhythms that help the business scale. You’ll partner closely with leaders across the company, own the financial model, and turn messy, ambiguous questions into clear decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who loves combining analytical rigor with strong business judgment and creative thinking. We don't envision this role as simply a gatekeeper of the budget (in fact, we don’t have budgets). As our first FP&A hire, you'll help make decisions that shape the next phase of the business's investments and growth.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the company’s financial model and forecasting process across revenue, expenses, headcount, and cash flow

 - Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles, including budgeting, reforecasting, and long-range planning

 - Partner with leaders across the company to help them make better, faster decisions through data and financial insight

 - Build clear reporting for leadership and analyze business performance against plan, identifying the biggest risks and opportunities

 - Create scenario analyses and business cases for new investments, hiring plans, and strategic initiatives

 - Improve and automate FP&A processes, systems, and reporting as the company scales


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5–10 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, or a similarly analytical role

 - Strong financial modeling skills and experience owning budgeting, forecasting, and headcount planning

 - Ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations and communicate effectively with stakeholders across the company

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes from scratch in a fast-growing environment

 - Strong AI and automation skills to improve Clay’s learning and growth cadence

 - Low ego, high ownership, and excited to work cross-functionally

DATA MARKETPLACE OPERATIONS @ CLAY

Clay's partner and data marketplace ecosystem powers our growth, but scaling effectively requires high-level strategic alignment, robust executive governance, and cohesive cross-functional leadership across our entire organization.

In this executive-facing role, you will lead the strategic planning, analytics, and operational machinery underlying Clay’s data marketplace and partner ecosystem. You'll drive long-term business planning, establish scalable margin and pricing methodologies, and lead cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Finance, Product, and Operations to position the Data Partnerships function for sustainable scale.

You will partner closely with executive leadership across Data Partnerships, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, Product and Engineering. This role reports directly to the Head of Data Partnerships.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, planning, and execution. You will partner across GTME, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Revenue Operations to solve complex business challenges, influence executive decision-making, and ensure the Data Partnerships organization is positioned to scale efficiently.

Strategic Planning & Executive Leadership

 - Lead quarterly and annual planning, key target setting, and resource allocation for the Data Partnerships organization

 - Establish executive dashboards and strategic reporting to evaluate marketplace performance, consumption trends, and partner unit economics for executive decision-making

 - Architect and implement scalable systems of record and operational governance for partner lifecycle management, CRM, and contract workflows across the business

 - Work closely with the Head of Finance and Head of Data Partnerships to design and/or evolve Clay’s partner model

Cross-Functional Operations & Marketplace Economics

 - Oversee the operational framework for invoice-to-cash, revenue reconciliation, and cost-of-goods-sold categorization across our data provider and product/technology partner portfolio

 - Drive operational alignment between Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM teams to ensure marketplace billing logic, commitment tracking, and P&L structure, systems and processes support rapid scaling

Commercial Strategy, Growth & Analytics

 - Partner with Finance and Executive Leadership to define commercial models, margin standards, and pricing strategies across white-label, BYOK, and marketplace constructs

 - Build margin and partner health reporting across every commercial model — data marketplace, white-label, and bring-your-own-license.

 - Design the economics for marketplace-wide distribution — private offers, featured collections, sponsored listings, and co-marketing placements — spanning existing partner tiers and the next iteration/evolution of our partner marketplace.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 10+ years of experience in strategy and operations, management consulting, or revenue operations, with significant exposure to marketplace, usage-based, or enterprise alliance models

 - Proven track record of partnering with executives to drive strategic business planning, cross-functional alignment, and operational transformation

 - Deep analytical capabilities with experience building financial models, executive dashboards, and strategic business cases

 - Cross-functional range: you can work with Legal on contract structure, Accounting on categorization and margin, and Product/Eng on how billing logic actually gets built

 - Comfortable building scalable process in a fast-moving environment — you'll be writing the playbook as the team scales, not executing someone else's

 - Bonus: experience with contract lifecycle management tools (Ironclad, Juro or similar), revenue-share or bring-your-own-license commercial models, or marketplace/platform monetization design

PRODUCT OPERATIONS @ CLAY

As Clay continues to scale, privacy and compliance have become core to how we operate and build trust with our customers. We're looking for a GRC Program Manager to build and own the operational systems that keep us compliant across vendor management, data privacy, and security. You'll be creating scalable processes from scratch to support teams across the company as they onboard vendors and handle customer information. You'll work at the intersection of engineering, security, legal and business teams to build processes that scales with our growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Vendor Onboarding & Risk Management: Build and own the end-to-end vendor onboarding compliance process. When teams want to onboard a new vendor, conduct proper review (DPA, SOC 2/GDPR data compliance), update our subprocessor list, and manage customer notifications

 - GRC Vendor Management: Serve as the internal owner and point of contact for external GRC vendors. Manage intake, ticketing, SLAs, quality review, and performance metrics to ensure security and compliance requests are tracked, resolved, and continuously improved

 - Compliance Reviews: Build processes for and complete compliance reviews when teams evaluate purchasing new data sets and vendor compliance.

 - Cross-Functional Program Building: Create operational processes and systems from scratch to scale compliance work across the company. You'll own programs end-to-end, not just coordinate projects

 - Customer Security Support: Assist in responding to security and privacy questionnaires from prospective and existing customers, with a particular focus on privacy, data protection, and compliance-related questions




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

 - 5+ years of experience building and scaling operational programs, ideally in a SaaS or tech environment

 - Strong builder mindset: you're excited to create processes and systems from scratch, not just maintain existing ones
